dedupe_keys.name: plantoact building stock and energy estimates for five european pilot regions

description: This dataset characterises the residential and service building stock and estimates its final energy use for space heating, space cooling and domestic hot water in the five pilot regions of the LIFE-funded PLANtoACT project. It was produced by Claudio Zandonella Callegher, Samuele Zilio, Valentina D'Alonzo and Matteo Giacomo Prina of Eurac Research under Work Package 2, Task 2.2, and version 2.0.0 was published on Zenodo on 9 September 2026. Building footprints from the JRC Digital Building Stock Model were calibrated against local statistics or enriched with local 3D building models, assigning typology, construction epoch and occupancy, and energy was computed by applying region-specific ratios to floor area; service buildings use EUBUCCO as reference. Coverage: Oberland (Germany), Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes (France), Lombardia (Italy), the Porto Metropolitan Area (Portugal) and Alba County (Romania). Access: one 1.66 GB zip on Zenodo with region folders and README files. Licence: Open Database License; free. Caveats: Portugal and Romania use global sources only, without local 3D models. Simulation uses: spatially detailed local energy planning, heat network screening and retrofit scenarios. Related records: the Modelblocks European building heat data and the Material stock maps.
